maria_support: incoming ticket from AcmeCorp — embeddings endpoint returning 1536-d vectors for some requests and 768-d for others, causing index failures. customer says this started after a backend rollout yesterday. ticket: AC-4891 :eyes:

maria_support: quick summary from logs: some requests to /v1/embeddings are being routed to `embed-v2-large` (1536) while others correctly hit `embed-v1` (768). they claim identical payloads. we suspect auth/project header mixup.

ryan_engineer: can you paste a raw request that hit the wrong model? any headers?

maria_support: yup — pasted below (sanitized):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED" \
  -H "X-Org-Id: org-acme" \
  -H "X-Project-Id: proj-acme-search" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input": "search term", "model": "embed-v1"}'
```

maria_support: response came back 200 with 1536-d vectors (embed-v2-large). customer says their SDK sets both X-Org-Id and X-Project-Id; older router logic looked at org-header first.

sophie_sre: FYI logs we pulled show router decision: ``route_decision: project_header=proj-acme-search, org_header=org-acme -> priority: ORG -> model=embed-v2-large``. timestamp 2026-03-13T22:12:09Z.

ryan_engineer: oh. that's the bug. we intended project header to override org default. looks like a regression in header precedence from the rollout. can you also attach one request-id that hit embed-v1 so I can compare full traces?

maria_support: attaching both request ids from customer (sanitized): rq_01GAAA..., rq_01GBBB... 

alex_runtime: grabbing traces now — rq_01GAAA... shows routing table lookup: matched org-default -> embed-v2-large, no project-override applied because router matched on `org_key` first and short-circuited. there is a small window where we load org config before project config due to async cache warmup.

maria_support: customer repro steps: 1) use SDK v2.1.0 with both X-Org-Id and X-Project-Id set; 2) send 100 requests concurrently (they use batching); 3) observe ~20% end up with 1536 vectors and throw "dimension mismatch" when inserted into their 768-d index.

ryan_engineer: batching + concurrency explains the race. if cache warmup returned org config first, router would pick org default. two fixes: (1) server: change precedence to prefer explicit `X-Project-Id` if present, and do not short-circuit before checking project cache; (2) support: advise customers to omit org header for project-scoped calls or upgrade SDK once we patch.

sophie_sre: also want to surface a defensive check — when model parameter (or returned vector dims) doesn't match the project's expected dimension, return 409 or at least a warning header so clients fail fast instead of silently returning mismatched vectors. customer hit index errors which are noisy.

maria_support: customer is asking for immediate mitigation. can we add a temporary gate that rejects requests with both headers and different default models? e.g., 400 + guidance message?

ryan_engineer: yes we can add an emergency middleware: if both headers present and project has an explicit model override, validate that the chosen route matches the model field in body (if provided) and the project's expected dim. if mismatch -> 400 + response: 

```json
{
  "error": "ambiguous-auth-headers",
  "message": "Both X-Org-Id and X-Project-Id provided — server routed to org-default model which differs from project expectation. Remove X-Org-Id or contact support to confirm routing."
}
```

alex_runtime: I'll put up the emergency patch to check header ambiguity and return 400. also scheduling a follow-up hotfix to the precedence bug. assigning to @ryan_engineer for the router change.

embed-bot: incident created INC-2026-322 (priority P2) — assigned: ryan_engineer, alex_runtime — status: investigating. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-322

maria_support: thanks. customer asked for a repro they can run internally to test the emergency gate. here's a curl they can run to see 400: 

```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED" \
  -H "X-Org-Id: org-acme" \
  -H "X-Project-Id: proj-acme-search" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"test","model":"embed-v1"}'

# expected: HTTP/1.1 400 
# body contains guidance about ambiguous headers
```

ryan_engineer: timeline — emergency gate pushed in next 30m (rollback safe), router precedence fix targeted for next deploy window (2 hours). I'll follow up in this thread with the PR link. :thumbsup:

sophie_sre: long-term: add unit+e2e tests for header precedence and a monitoring alert when returned vector dimension != expected. creating an alert in sentry/metrics for dimension-mismatch-rate > 0.5% over 5m.

maria_support: customer replied: grateful, wants ETA for fix and a temporary workaround. gave them the curl + advised removal of X-Org-Id for project calls. I'll keep them updated.

ryan_engineer: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/542 (wip) — adds project-first precedence and middleware for ambiguous headers. leaving notes in PR for QA.

alex_runtime: rolled emergency gate to canary in us-west-2. monitoring looks stable so far, blocking mixed-header requests. will escalate to full rollout after 10m of green.

maria_support: closing loop with customer — they'll test and reopen if anything. thanks team. :heart:

embed-bot: incident INC-2026-322 updated: status -> resolved (mitigated) at 2026-03-13T23:05:10Z

maria_support: leaving this thread open until router patch is in prod.
